sections.title: Prompt Engineering
sections.systemPrompt: Expert board-certified radiologist AI analyzing PadChest CXR

criticalIssues.issue: 200 GB ≠ full PadChest — only ~25-30% of 160K images
criticalIssues.impact: Model sees 30-40K images instead of 160K. Rare findings (174 categories) will be severely underrepresented. Long-tail distribution becomes cliff.
criticalIssues.fix: MUST filter CSV to only rows where images exist locally. Current code does this (image_exists check) but 8 epochs on 30K is NOT equivalent to 8 epochs on 160K.

criticalIssues.issue: Image resolution downscaled: 512x512 vs SigLIP native 896x896
criticalIssues.impact: SigLIP encoder was pre-trained on 896x896. Feeding 512x512 loses ~67% of pixel information. The processor resizes internally but quality is already lost.
criticalIssues.fix: Change cfg.image_size to 896. VRAM cost is minimal because SigLIP handles its own resize. Only disk I/O and preprocessing CPU time increase.

criticalIssues.issue: Curriculum learning on partial dataset may over-represent easy cases
criticalIssues.impact: Sorting by difficulty then taking 90% for train means test set is ALL hard cases. Validation metrics will be artificially pessimistic.
criticalIssues.fix: Either disable curriculum (shuffle randomly) or split FIRST then sort within train split only.

criticalIssues.issue: Label masking in collate_fn is naive
criticalIssues.impact: labels[labels == pid] = -100 masks ALL pad tokens but doesn't mask the system/user prompt tokens. Model trains on predicting the prompt tokens too, wasting capacity.
criticalIssues.fix: Use DataCollatorForCompletionOnlyLM from TRL, or manually find the assistant response start token and mask everything before it.

criticalIssues.issue: No data augmentation for medical images
criticalIssues.impact: With only 30-40K images, overfitting risk is HIGH. No horizontal flip, rotation, brightness jitter, or elastic deformation.
criticalIssues.fix: Add conservative augmentations: small rotation (±5°), slight brightness/contrast jitter. DO NOT horizontal flip (laterality matters in CXR).

criticalIssues.issue: build_assistant_response pairs ALL locations with each finding
criticalIssues.impact: If findings=[cardiomegaly, pneumothorax] and locations=[right lung, cardiac], report says 'Cardiomegaly (right lung, cardiac)' and 'Pneumothorax (right lung, cardiac)' — location attribution is wrong.
criticalIssues.fix: Need finding-to-location mapping from LabelsLocalizationsBySentence column.

criticalIssues.issue: max_seq_length=768 may truncate complex multi-finding reports
criticalIssues.impact: Reports with 5+ findings + locations + impression can exceed 768 tokens. Truncated labels = incomplete training signal.
criticalIssues.fix: Measure actual sequence length distribution. Consider 1024 if VRAM allows.

200gbDataStrategy.expectedFindings: ~100-120 of 174 unique findings (rare ones missing entirely)
200gbDataStrategy.recommendation: Focus training on findings that appear >=10 times in available data. Filter out ultra-rare findings to avoid noise.
200gbDataStrategy.epochsNeeded: Can train more epochs (10-12) since dataset is smaller — faster per-epoch time with local NVMe
